BLAKE3 1.8.5, official C implementation (https://github.com/BLAKE3-team/BLAKE3), taken unchanged from lazy_crc
(E:\Downloads\lazy_crc-master\lazy_crc\include\blake3). Dual licensed CC0 1.0 / Apache 2.0 by the BLAKE3 authors.
The *_windows_msvc.asm files are the x64 SIMD kernels for MSVC (ml64), other compilers use the portable code.
